explanation: The pieces, called tans, are five triangles in three sizes, a square and a parallelogram. Fitted together they form a square, and they can be rearranged into hundreds of silhouettes.

claims.text: A traditional tangram puzzle has seven flat pieces.
A traditional tangram does not have 5, 6 or 9 pieces.
The seven tangram pieces are five right isosceles triangles (two large, one medium and two small), a square and a parallelogram.
The tangram pieces are called tans, and together they can be arranged into a square.
Hundreds of different figures and silhouettes can be made from the tangram pieces.

stem: How many flat pieces make up a traditional Chinese tangram puzzle?

evidence.restatement: The classic tangram has seven pieces, called tans.

claimResults.note: Rival test: 5, 6 and 9 are not variants of the traditional set (other dissection puzzles like the 14-piece Ostomachion are different).

evidence.restatement: The standard set is never five, six or nine pieces.

claimResults.note: Traditional is specified in the stem, excluding modern variants.

evidence.restatement: The set is made of two big, one middle-sized and two small right isosceles triangles, one square and one parallelogram.
Tans is the name for the pieces, and the full set tiles a square.
Collections list well over a thousand tangram shapes, so hundreds is a safe underestimate.
